reason: A modular AI-agent engineering framework that routes project tasks through planning, analysis, reverse-engineering, coding, knowledge, and validation skills, with installers and optional DeepSeek Harness integration.

summaries.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的模块化工程框架，用于编排规划、项目分析、逆向工程、编程、知识管理和验证工作流。
summaries.en: A modular AI-agent engineering framework for orchestrating planning, project analysis, reverse engineering, coding, knowledge management, and validation workflows.

capabilities: Routes engineering tasks to modular skills and subagent roles
Creates project artifact, investigation, knowledge, and index structures
Installs, upgrades, validates, and uninstalls framework files in a target project
Provides optional DSH host integration with skills, tools, and an agent preset
